listing.name: OpenClonk
listing.summary: Explore caves, build settlements, and play strategy and action scenarios in this free successor to Clonk.
listing.download_block_reason: Install and update OpenClonk through the publisher or your package manager.

steps.title: Install OpenClonk
steps.instruction: On Windows x64, use the Windows 64-bit installer. On Linux, use your distribution’s openclonk package or the community OpenClonk Flatpak for x86-64. Debian also packages OpenClonk for ARM64. The publisher’s Linux archives were built with Ubuntu 16.04, so try your distribution’s package first on a newer system.

steps.title: Choose a player and scenario
steps.instruction: Create a player, or select an existing one under Player Selection and choose Activate. Open Start Game, open Tutorials, and start Wandering Wipf to learn the controls. The packages include the game data.

warnings: Close OpenClonk before copying players, scenarios, or saves. Keep any custom user data directory or separate configuration file you selected.

references.title: Find your player data
references.instruction: On Windows, look under %APPDATA%\OpenClonk. Windows stores default settings in HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\OpenClonk Project\OpenClonk. Keep that key if you want to transfer these settings. On Linux, keep ~/.clonk/openclonk, including its config file. The Flatpak profile is ~/.var/app/org.openclonk.OpenClonk/.clonk/openclonk.
